args.summary: Overnight de-risk of a queued book that was already defensive (70% cash, 30% gross). The live overnight tape is selling off — risk_state ELEVATED — but orderly, not a crash: US futures avg -0.84% with NQ -1.52% leading, Asia heavy (KOSPI -3.56%, Hang Seng -2.92%, Nikkei -2.55%), while VIX is actually DOWN 3.64% to 16.68 and Europe is green (DAX +1.35%). The driver is rising yields (10Y +0.57% to 5.15%), a direct headwind to long-duration tech/semis. The one proportionate change tonight: full exit of MU — a memory/semiconductor name that is the single holding most exposed to exactly what is selling off (NQ, KOSPI, rising yields), carries no live thesis (null rationale, Prophet held_without_active_plan), is -14.6% with SMH 20d momentum -8.07%. XOM is the overnight WINNER (crude +2.15%, XLE RS #1) and stays; MSFT is the defensive quality anchor far above invalidation and stays; AAPL is a trivial toehold not worth the spread. No new risk added into a selling-off, low-confidence-regime tape.

holdings.rationale: The single fully-confirmed leadership position in the book and the overnight tape's clear winner: WTI crude +2.15% overnight while equities sell off, Energy (XLE) is sector RS rank #1 (20d momentum +8.5%), decision matrix confirmed uptrend above 50/200d. Rising-inflation regime (inflation score +0.24) and the energy complex are direct tailwinds. Satisfies Charter P1 across price, sector, theme and macro planes — not the label alone.
holdings.why_now: Crude +2.15% on the overnight tape makes energy the relative winner while tech/semis and Asia sell off; no reason to reduce the one confirmed leader into a tape that favors it.
holdings.falsifier: Crude reverses and XLE loses RS rank #1, or XOM breaks the Prophet invalidation at 131.13 (price 178.09).
holdings.exit_plan: Exit on a close below 50d or Prophet invalidation 131.13, or if crude/XLE leadership breaks. Trim if weight runs well above the energy sleeve budget.

holdings.rationale: Quality mega-cap core anchor. Prophet management plan is hold (triggered_pre_t1) with price ~533 far above the 341.6 invalidation. Durable FCF and low fundamental fragility make it the appropriate equity anchor in an elevated-drawdown, weak-breadth, rising-yield tape. Modest 10% position, +4%, no thesis break.
holdings.why_now: NQ -1.52% overnight is a tech-led, yield-driven wobble with VIX falling (16.68) — an orderly dip, not stress. Trimming the quality anchor on a one-session move with VIX low would be an over-reaction; it stays as the defensive equity ballast. Not adding into the selloff.
holdings.falsifier: Close below the Prophet invalidation at 341.6, or VIX spikes above 25 confirming genuine stress rather than orderly de-risk.

holdings.exit_plan: Exit on a close below 341.6 or a durable FCF/thesis break; trim if a genuine risk-off (VIX>25, breadth collapse) confirms.

holdings.rationale: Trivial residual quality toehold (0.74% weight, +13%) left from a prior disciplined trim. Prophet shows held_without_active_plan but it carries no negative signal; too small to matter to risk and not worth paying spread/slippage to close.
holdings.why_now: At 0.74% it is immaterial to tonight's de-risk; closing it costs spread for no risk benefit. Left untouched while the real de-risk (MU) is executed.
holdings.falsifier: A clear negative signal (Prophet invalidation / decision-matrix bear flip) that would justify paying the spread to close it.
holdings.exit_plan: Fold into the next rebalance or close if it develops a negative signal; no active plan today.

exit_decisions.reason: Full exit as the proportionate overnight de-risk. MU is the single holding most exposed to exactly what the live tape is selling off — a memory/semiconductor name hit by NQ -1.52%, KOSPI -3.56% (semi-heavy) and the 10Y rising to 5.15% (direct long-duration headwind). It carries no live thesis (rationale was null; Prophet lists it held_without_active_plan), is -14.6% unrealized after only 16 days, and SMH 20d momentum is -8.07%. No confirmation plane supports it. Cutting it is the cleanest way to honor the de-risk directive and the ROTATE_DEFENSIVE posture without touching confirmed leaders.
